node.statement: From the displayed minimum formula, epsilon<=W.epsilon_MAIN is at most W.r_reset/W.K_call, e_sim/W.K_call, and e_full/W.K_call. Since W.K_call>0, multiplication by W.K_call yields W.K_call*epsilon<=W.r_reset, W.K_call*epsilon<=e_sim, and W.K_call*epsilon<=e_full.
